manual_clone_growth_completed.formula: Increment progress.manual_clone_growth_completed by exactly 1 after successful clone_nursery.harvest with an existing pull whose automatic == false. Failed harvest, direct create_clone, automatic extraction and loading do not increment. Assistance with feeding/watering is allowed.
manual_clone_growth_completed.storage: CafeProgression.snapshot/restore; first count records first_manual_clone_growth_completed; count >= 2 records repeat_manual_clone_growth_completed

unique_current_workers.formula: Set of positive clone IDs: service.clone_options() entries id, de-duplicated. Assigned and free workers count; players, zero-ID placeholders, recordings and former/deleted workers do not. count >= 6 records staff_6_seen; count >= 9 records staff_9_seen.
unique_current_workers.integration: Add explicit _current_staff_count() and two _record_milestone calls before reconcile, payload {count:actual_count}; no new persisted numeric counter is needed.

8→9 unlocks second-scale group only at 4★ with solyanka
losing workers never removes a recorded unlock

formula_improvement_relevant.formula: Exists a real unique worker with id > 0 and worker.tempo < progress.lab_formula_tempo. Include free_workers.id and station.crew.clone_id. The first useful result is sticky.
formula_improvement_relevant.source: ProgressionDirector._formula_improvement_relevant during _refresh_progression after formula scan or changed worker roster
tests: any number of unsuccessful experiments false
current chair command still rejects a selected worker with tempo >= formula

first_recalibration_completed.formula: At CloneRecalibrator.begin_return, actual worker.tempo > state.start + 0.00001 and clone_id > 0. Only actual improvement counts; successful automatic partial improvement also counts.
first_recalibration_completed.source: clone_recalibrator.gd::begin_return -> observe(recalibration_completed,{clone_id,before,after}); revision, selection, walking or cancellation without gain never count.

paired_kitchen_mastery.formula: Completed automatic customer whose production station.type_id == kitchen and dish == meal. A valid current method and its current crew are needed for structural star readiness; first_pair_kitchen_auto_served is historical proof.

room_expansion_facts.formula: progress.lounge_tier >= 1 -> lounge_expansion_1_completed; progress.lounge_tier >= 2 -> lounge_expansion_2_completed. Record after successful purchase(kind=lounge_expansion) and recover from actual tier on current save/load.
tests: room 1 plus group milestone opens rest_games without any hobbies owned
content.lounge_expansion.2 must NOT depend on rest_large (its reward)

base_lab_purchase.formula: Introduced when clone_lab unlocked AND lab_stage >= numeric suffix; owned when lab_stage > suffix. For a new purchase require lab_stage == suffix, no same pending parcel, sufficient cash, not busy, host. Subsequent base parts cannot be ordered before physical installation of previous part.
base_lab_purchase.integration: FeatureAccess.item_access/check_action and CafeShop.order use same predicate; delivery install advances lab_stage.

laboratory_purchase.formula: Known group remains visible. Enable only if lab_stage >= 3 AND lab_tier >= item.dependencies.room.lab_tier_min AND all installed_items_all are in progress.lab_upgrades AND not already installed/pending AND sufficient cash AND not busy AND host. min_stars/counters/milestones introduce the feature, they are not a second divergent gate.
laboratory_purchase.integration: Extract a shared typed purchase validation consumed by FeatureAccess and LaboratoryProgression.error; keep domain check on host.

lounge_purchase.formula: Known group remains visible; upgrades become visible only after base lounge_id installed. Enable only if lounge_tier >= item.dependencies.room.lounge_tier_min AND base installed for upgrade AND not owned/pending AND sufficient cash AND not busy AND host. rest_television requires only video_training plus tier 0; no rest feature or expansion or sofa prerequisite.
lounge_purchase.integration: Shared rule used by FeatureAccess and LoungeProgression.item_error; normalize rest_upgrade_X -> rest_X before feature lookup.

room_expansion.formula: Use expansion.features_all/milestones_all/min_stars for unlock. Enable when current tier == tier_from, host, no sleeping players, not busy and cash >= price. The first expansion is the only prerequisite purchase for tier 2.
room_expansion.integration: cafe_service_feature_core.gd::_purchase_access, cafe_service_core.gd::purchase, Office.room_offer, LaboratoryProgression.expand, LoungeProgression.expand share the same check; return concrete identical reason.

view_state.formula: Future group: hidden. Introduced group: visible even at zero cash, while busy or after staff reduction. Owned: owned; in delivery: pending; lacking room/dependency/money: blocked with first concrete reason; otherwise ready. Seen/announced and postponed tutorial never influence command allowed.
view_state.integration: FeatureAccess remains authoritative for UI and host commands; do not keep a separate item.star gate with a different minimum.
